name: Deerfield
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Deerfield, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Deerfield, IL: an ice sculpting and tractor ride night at Village Hall, then a Winter Market with Santa and a Polar Express train.
lede: Deerfield packs its Christmas into one village weekend in December: a Friday night Winter Celebration at Village Hall, then a Saturday Winter Market with Santa, an outdoor Polar Express train and a giant snow globe.
celebrates: Christmas in Deerfield centers on the Village of Deerfield's two-day winter weekend. On Friday night, families gather at Village Hall on Waukegan Road to watch a live ice sculptor, ride tractor-pulled wagons, hear the Deerfield High School Choraliers and the Frozen Robins, and warm up with roasted chestnuts and cider while the mayor lights up Village Hall. The next morning, the Winter Market fills the Patty Turner Center on Elm Street with local makers, food vendors and civic groups. Children visit Santa and Mrs. Claus, ride an outdoor Polar Express train, step into a giant snow globe and listen to a story read by the mayor. The library adds holiday concerts and model trains in December.
lastyear: For 2025 the village planned a Winter Lighting Celebration at Village Hall on Friday, December 5, from 5 to 8 pm, with ice sculpting, tractor rides, the Choraliers and Frozen Robins, as Mayor Shapiro illuminated Village Hall to start the season. The Winter Market was planned for Saturday, December 6, at the Patty Turner Center, with a giant outdoor snow globe, a visit from Santa and a Polar Express train ride. Both events had collection bins for the Rotary Club's Coat Off Your Back drive.
facts: Deerfield's winter celebration has changed over the years. One earlier version ran 5 to 9 pm with horse-drawn carriage rides on the Village Hall lawn, then pony rides and carriage rides at Deerfield Square the next day, plus model trains by the North Central O Gaugers at the library. The Deerfield Police Department's holiday toy drive reached its 15th year for Lutheran General Hospital in 2025. The Deerfield Park District, which hosts the Winter Market on its calendar, is celebrating 75 years.
trains: Deerfield has two Metra stations on the Milwaukee District North line, which runs from Chicago Union Station to Fox Lake. The Deerfield station at 860 Deerfield Road sits 24.6 miles from Union Station, and Lake Cook Road station is at 601 Lake Cook Road. The Deerfield depot dates to 1903, was rebuilt after a 1917 fire and joined the National Register of Historic Places in 1998. For a bigger train day, the Illinois Railway Museum in Union includes unlimited train rides with admission.
train_links: The largest railway museum in the US, with unlimited train rides included, in Union, Illinois.
traditions: A live ice sculptor carves on the Friday night of the Winter Celebration while families watch.
Tractor wagon rides run continuously at Village Hall all evening during the Winter Celebration.
Santa and Mrs. Claus spend the whole Winter Market at the Patty Turner Center.
Polar Express train and snow globe
An outdoor Polar Express train and a giant snow globe sit outside the Winter Market.
Mayor Shapiro reads a holiday story to children during the Winter Market.
Coat and toy drives collect donations at village events and buildings each December.
kidfact: Deerfield's train station caught fire in 1917, and only the freight room survived. It was rebuilt on the old foundation, and it still has its old windows and radiators.
faq: When is the Deerfield Winter Celebration?

The Village of Deerfield holds its Winter Celebration on a Friday evening in early to mid December at Village Hall, 850 Waukegan Road, from 5 to 8 pm. It kicks off a two-day weekend, and the Winter Market follows the next morning at the Patty Turner Center. The village posts the year's date on its Winter Market page and in its e-newsletter.
Where can kids see Santa in Deerfield?

Santa and Mrs. Claus visit the Village of Deerfield's Winter Market at the Patty Turner Center, 375 Elm Street, on the Saturday of the village's winter weekend. They stay for the whole market, and children can also mail a letter to the North Pole, ride an outdoor Polar Express train and see a giant snow globe there.
Is the Deerfield Winter Market free?

Yes. The Deerfield Park District calendar has listed the Village of Deerfield's Winter Market as free, and Visit Lake County lists free admission for both the Winter Celebration and the Winter Market. Food vendors and craft sellers charge for what they sell, so bring some money if you plan to shop or eat.
Is there a train ride at Deerfield's Christmas events?

Yes. The Winter Market has an outdoor Polar Express train for children, set up outside the Patty Turner Center. For a real train, the Deerfield and Lake Cook Road Metra stations are on the Milwaukee District North line to Chicago Union Station, and the Illinois Railway Museum in Union offers unlimited rides with admission.
What else happens in Deerfield at Christmas?

The Deerfield Public Library schedules holiday concerts and model train displays in December, and the village and its partners run donation drives. The Rotary Club's Coat Off Your Back drive has collected winter coats at Village Hall, the library, the Patty Turner Center and other spots, and the Deerfield Police Department runs a yearly holiday toy drive.
